title: Geologic Map of the North Island Quadrangle, Georgetown County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2012, Geologic Map of the North Island Quadrangle, Georgetown County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-183, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; text panels legible, map face garbled. Most map symbols garbled and left out (QHe and QPsbs clear; QHsm inferred from placement). Two thicknesses print '|' for a digit (read as 1, inferred, sent to review). Munsell 'N35' and 'SY 8/1' kept as printed. Legend-only items (contact, drill hole NI-1) not recorded.
SUBSURFACE: p.1 gives elevation ranges of terrace-sediment margins (Holocene <10 ft landward; Silver Bluff >6/<10 ft; Princess Anne >12/<18 ft; Pamlico terrace landward), stored as contacts; estuarine/marine unit beneath Princess Anne terrace has lower part 10-20 ft and upper part 1-10 ft thick; vertical datum not stated (horizontal 1927 North American Datum; contour interval 20 feet; base map USGS 1973); SCGS drill-hole locations with field IDs on map (logs on file at SCGS, not included). No cross sections or structure-contour maps.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; text panels legible, map face garbled). Units as before; map symbols garbled in the OCR (QHe, QPsbs, and QHsm clear or inferred) were read from the legend boxes on page-image tiles (crop of the legend column). Terrace-sediment margin elevations (Holocene <10 ft landward; Silver Bluff >6 ft seaward, <10 ft landward; Princess Anne >12 ft seaward, <18 ft landward) are recorded again as unit contacts and also as stated unit tops at those margins (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Two thicknesses print '|' for a digit (read as 1, inferred). Munsell 'N35' and 'SY 8/1' kept as printed. No cross section or structure contours on the sheet; SCGS drill holes (NI-1 to NI-29) are plotted on the map face by label only, with no depths or logs (logs on file at SCGS), so none is recorded. Legend-only contact and drill-hole symbols not recorded.
